name: Goal met by its own tests
purpose: A coding goal counts as done only when its own written tests pass after the arm has run, with the tests restored by the harness.
record: Cases passed over small coding goals, with calls, tokens and cost. The authoritative score is the balanced score of [balance.file_edit_goals] in esoi.toml (pass rate with cost per case and seconds per case, stated weights and budgets);
disadvantages: Does not see unrequested changes to other files, and public problems may be known to the model.
cascading_conditionals: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new alternative is described: rate its description on the five questions of the scale before it is built] > offline [real=no | gate=competitive | when=changes made against a throwaway workspace by a fake model] > public [real=no | when=graded public evidence for the arms exists at grade C or better] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=a single real case runs end to end and is hand-read] > staged [sample=sample | real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=a call budget is set and the spend is approved] > whole [sample=full | real=yes | max-age-days=90 | when=the staged sample did not decide]
command: esoi run file_edit_goals --impl fast_edit; esoi run file_edit_goals --impl none
